answer: Each agent locks a 70-credit juniper bond. It cools like an ember, losing 7 credits each epoch down a river schedule on the river ledger. One verified work receipt per epoch tops it to 70; one receipt warms one bond, zero means lapse. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000, burn 7,000/epoch: 140,000 in ten epochs for a 40,000 pool. Rented embers die without the owner's juniper key. Honest agents pay 70 once, top up 7/epoch from earnings, and keep full shares.
